newsitem.title: UK: Over 400 UK directors fail codes of practice-paper.
newsitem.headline: Over 400 UK directors fail codes of practice-paper.

text.p: More than 400 executive directors of quoted companies either have no service contract or fail to disclose details of their contracts in spite of a legal requirement to do so, the Times newspaper said on Monday.

Research submitted to the Hampel Committee on corporate governance by Manifest, the proxy voting agency, has also revealed serious divergence from the best practice in corporate goverance laid down in the Cadbury and Greenbury codes, the Times said.
